Command: Do not graft trees of diverse kinds
Summary: One of the mixture laws of Leviticus 19:19: do not graft trees of diverse kinds. The verse as written forbids mingled seed in the field; the tradition counts grafting of diverse trees as a distinct mixture law under the same verse. Doubt: whether grafting stands as a separate enumeration distinct from the field-seed mixture law is debated in the tradition, and the verse itself speaks of mingled seed rather than grafting by name.
Commandment: Do not graft trees of diverse kinds
Application: TRADITIONAL reading: the mixture law is classed among the chukim, statutes whose reason Scripture does not state; like the other mixture laws of Leviticus 19:19 it belonged to Israel's land law under the Sinai covenant.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: no reason is stated in Scripture; the mixture law is classed among the chukim. Duration Temporary because it is a Mosaic land law bound to Israel under the Sinai covenant, of the same kind as the other mixture laws of Leviticus 19:19, which the collection files as Temporary.
